title: Design System: RiftX Web Control Plane

display.purpose: Major Dashboard, New Run, and operation headings.

label.purpose: Commands, tabs, badges, kickers, and compact metadata.

data.purpose: Identifiers, code, tables, traffic metadata, evidence, and dispositions.

shadows.name: panel-hard-edge
shadows.value: inset 2px 2px 0 var(--pc-inset-hi), inset -2px -2px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--pc-space) 70%, transparent), 4px 4px 0 var(--pc-shadow)
shadows.purpose: Structural depth for panels, cards, loading, and error surfaces.

shadows.name: control-hard-edge
shadows.value: inset -2px -2px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--pc-space) 66%, transparent), 3px 3px 0 var(--pc-shadow)

shadows.name: terminal-inset
shadows.purpose: Hard containment for terminal output without glow.

motion.name: state-step-core
motion.purpose: Core navigation and control state changes.

motion.name: state-step-dense
motion.purpose: Dense operation-workspace controls and action cards.

motion.name: pixel-signal
motion.purpose: Live and waiting signal indicators only.

motion.name: pixel-spin
motion.purpose: Loading spinner rotation; disabled under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Highest-priority core command action with hard pixel depth.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; border: 2px solid var(--pc-blue); border-top-color: var(--pc-cyan); border-left-color: var(--pc-cyan); border-radius: 0; color: var(--pc-cyan-hi); background: var(--pc-button); box-shadow: inset -2px -2px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--pc-space) 66%, transparent), 3px 3px 0 var(--pc-shadow); padding: 0 14px; font-family: var(--pixel-heading); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.3; clip-path: var(--pixel-cut); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 90ms steps(2, end), background-color 90ms steps(2, end); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: var(--pc-cyan); background: var(--pc-button-hover); transform: translate(-1px, -1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--pc-cyan-hi); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { box-shadow: inset 2px 2px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--pc-space) 70%, transparent); transform: translate(2px, 2px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-priority inspection, cancellation, and navigation action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; border: 2px solid var(--pc-line); border-top-color: var(--pc-blue); border-left-color: var(--pc-blue); border-radius: 0; color: var(--pc-muted); background: var(--pc-deep-blue); box-shadow: inset -2px -2px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--pc-space) 66%, transparent), 3px 3px 0 var(--pc-shadow); padding: 0 14px; font-family: var(--pixel-heading); font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.3; clip-path: var(--pixel-cut); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 90ms steps(2, end), background-color 90ms steps(2, end); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--pc-cyan); color: var(--pc-cyan-hi); background: var(--pc-button-hover); transform: translate(-1px, -1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--pc-cyan-hi); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { box-shadow: none; transform: translate(3px, 3px); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Explicit emergency-stop or cleanup action; never a generic destructive accent.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { min-height: 44px; border: 2px solid var(--pc-red); border-top-color: #ff9eb2; border-left-color: #ff9eb2; border-radius: 0; color: var(--danger-strong); background: var(--pc-red-deep); box-shadow: inset -2px -2px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--pc-red) 35%, var(--pc-space)), 3px 3px 0 var(--pc-shadow); padding: 0 14px; font-family: var(--pixel-heading); font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.3; clip-path: var(--pixel-cut); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 90ms steps(2, end), background-color 90ms steps(2, end); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { border-color: #ff9eb2; color: #ffffff; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pc-red-deep) 75%, var(--pc-red)); transform: translate(-1px, -1px); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--pc-cyan-hi); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-danger:active { box-shadow: none; transform: translate(3px, 3px); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Square operational input with an inset cyan focus marker.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: var(--pc-text); } .ds-field-label { color: var(--pc-cyan); font-family: var(--pixel-heading); font-size: 9px; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-field-input { min-height: 44px; border: 2px solid var(--pc-line); border-radius: 0; outline: none; color: var(--pc-text); background: var(--pc-input); box-shadow: inset 2px 2px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--pc-space) 46%, transparent); padding: 10px 11px; font-family: var(--pixel-mono); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.55; transition: border-color 90ms steps(2, end), box-shadow 90ms steps(2, end); } .ds-field-input:hover { border-color: var(--pc-blue); } .ds-field-input:focus { border-color: var(--pc-cyan); box-shadow: inset 4px 0 0 var(--pc-cyan), inset 2px 2px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--pc-space) 46%, transparent); } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--pc-cyan-hi); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: Selected command-rail destination with pixel glyph and gold corner markers.
components.html: RUNS
components.css: .ds-nav-active { position: relative; display: grid; width: 58px; min-height: 54px; place-items: center; align-content: center; gap: 4px; border: 2px solid var(--pc-cyan); border-radius: 0; color: var(--pc-cyan-hi); background: var(--pc-panel-blue); box-shadow: inset 2px 2px 0 rgba(168, 237, 255, 0.2), 3px 3px 0 var(--pc-shadow); padding: 4px 2px; font-family: var(--pixel-heading); font-size: 8px; line-height: 1.15; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-active svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; image-rendering: pixelated; } .ds-nav-active::before, .ds-nav-active::after { position: absolute; width: 4px; height: 4px; background: var(--pc-gold); content: ""; } .ds-nav-active::before { top: -2px; left: -2px; } .ds-nav-active::after { right: -2px; bottom: -2px; } .ds-nav-active:hover { background: var(--pc-panel-hi); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--pc-cyan-hi); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav-active:active { box-shadow: none; transform: translate(3px, 3px); }

components.name: Waiting Approval Badge
components.description: Gold, textual waiting state with a non-circular pixel indicator.
components.css: .ds-status-approval { display: inline-flex; min-height: 28px; align-items: center; gap: 7px; border: 2px solid var(--pc-gold); border-radius: 0; color: var(--pc-gold); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pc-gold) 11%, var(--pc-panel)); padding: 0 8px; font-family: var(--pixel-heading); font-size: 9px; line-height: 1.25; text-transform: uppercase; clip-path: var(--pixel-cut); } .ds-status-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 0; background: currentcolor; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, currentcolor 34%, transparent); animation: ds-pixel-signal 1.2s steps(2, end) infinite; } @keyframes ds-pixel-signal { 0%, 45% { opacity: 1; } 50%, 100% { opacity: 0.35; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-status-dot { animation: none; } }

components.name: Tactical Panel
components.description: Canonical framed container for durable operational data.
components.html:
RUN FACTSLIFECYCLE
Persisted state remains the source of truth.
components.css: .ds-panel { overflow: hidden; border: 2px solid var(--pc-line); border-radius: 0; color: var(--pc-text); background: var(--pc-panel); box-shadow: inset 2px 2px 0 var(--pc-inset-hi), inset -2px -2px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--pc-space) 70%, transparent), 4px 4px 0 var(--pc-shadow); clip-path: var(--pixel-cut); } .ds-panel-header { display: flex; min-height: 54px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--pc-blue); color: var(--pc-cyan-hi); background: var(--pc-panel-hi); padding: 10px 13px; } .ds-panel-header strong { font-family: var(--pixel-heading); font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-panel-header span { color: var(--pc-dim); font-family: var(--pixel-heading); font-size: 7px; } .ds-panel-body { padding: 14px; color: var(--pc-muted); font-family: var(--pixel-mono); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Approval Alert
components.description: Signature durable-state alert that routes the operator to exact approval context.
components.css: .ds-approval-alert { display: grid; width: 100%; grid-template-columns: 20px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border: 2px solid var(--pc-gold); border-radius: 0; color: var(--pc-gold); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pc-gold) 11%, var(--pc-panel)); box-shadow: inset 2px 2px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--pc-gold) 22%, transparent), 3px 3px 0 var(--pc-shadow); padding: 12px 14px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 90ms steps(2, end), background-color 90ms steps(2, end); } .ds-approval-alert svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; } .ds-approval-alert span { display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-approval-alert strong { font-family: var(--pixel-heading); font-size: 9px; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-approval-alert small { color: var(--pc-muted); font-family: var(--pixel-mono); font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-approval-alert b { font-family: var(--pixel-heading); } .ds-approval-alert:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pc-gold) 16%, var(--pc-panel)); transform: translate(-1px, -1px); } .ds-approval-alert:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--pc-cyan-hi); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-approval-alert:active { box-shadow: none; transform: translate(3px, 3px); }

narrative.northStar: Blue Team Cartridge / 蓝队战术卡带
narrative.overview:
RiftX is a blue 16-bit tactical operator terminal: cobalt command frames, cyan telemetry, pixel glyphs, hard-edged map tiles, and compact data panels make an authorized red-team operation feel like a serious cartridge-era control surface. The calibrated expression is Variance 7 / Motion 3 / Density 8—distinctive and dense, but never visually noisy enough to obscure scope, evidence, approval, or stop proof.

The WebUI is a projection of durable state, not the owner of the work. Visual emphasis therefore follows operational truth: authorization boundaries precede action, pause and emergency stop fence new effects first, and terminal state is not visually claimed until Execution, Browser session, and Target HTTP request dispositions are explicit. Dark and light themes, English and Chinese, keyboard operation, and non-color status language preserve the same tactical grammar.
keyCharacteristics: Blue 16-bit tactical-console world with restrained micro-pixel craft.
Dense, scan-first information hierarchy anchored by durable state.
Square 2px frames, stepped cuts, and hard 3–4px pixel shadows.
Cyan command/telemetry, gold approval, green confirmation, and red danger semantics.
Persistent bilingual light/dark operation with visible focus and reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Semantic Signal Rule
rules.body: Cyan means command or telemetry, gold means approval or waiting, green means affirmative confirmation, and red means danger, failure, or unconfirmed stop; always pair color with explicit text, iconography, or disposition.

rules.name: The Silkscreen Restraint Rule
rules.body: Use the pixel face for commands, labels, compact headings, and identity; use system monospace for sentences, evidence, bilingual content, and long data.

rules.name: The Durable View Rule
rules.body: The first viewport prioritizes location, Run status, authorized objective, node/model/mode, outstanding approvals, and real controls—not decorative metrics, XP, or score.

rules.name: The Hard Depth Rule
rules.body: Every elevation cue must read as a pixel offset or inset frame; never soften it into ambient blur or purple glow.

rules.name: The Cartridge Geometry Rule
rules.body: Keep corners square, borders two pixels, and cuts stepped; do not introduce rounded SaaS cards or pill controls.

rules.name: The Safety State Rule
rules.body: Requested, persisted, synchronized, and physically confirmed are different states; components must name the current state and must never optimistically collapse them.

dos: **Do** preserve the Blue Team Cartridge world across Dashboard, New Run, Run Detail, administration, gate, dark/light, and English/Chinese surfaces.
**Do** keep authorization scope, exclusions, approval context, durable evidence, and stop disposition visible at the decision boundary.
**Do** use real persisted state and explicit loading, empty, stale, error, disabled, and unconfirmed-stop language.
**Do** preserve keyboard tab behavior, focus restoration, ARIA semantics, 3px focus-visible outlines, 44px mobile targets, and reduced-motion handling.
**Do** reveal only the minimum safe metadata needed by the local operator.
donts: **Don't** use Matrix rain, purple glow, skulls, XP, score, fake terminal theater, or generic hacker clichés.
**Don't** imply that closing the browser stops a Run or that a requested pause/emergency stop proves every effect has stopped.
**Don't** expose secrets, credentials, full sensitive URLs, Runner-local paths, request/response bodies, headers, cookies, or authentication material.
**Don't** fabricate customers, metrics, benchmarks, CVSS scores, public-deployment claims, or real engagement data.
**Don't** encode approval risk, failure, or unconfirmed stop with color or animation alone.
